entities.name: UDP-MurNAc-tripeptide ligase
observations: 496-aa query matches reviewed Xanthomonas UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate--2,6-diaminopimelate ligases at 72.6–73.6% identity and 100% coverage; assignment is strong homology support, not direct experimental validation of the query.
Likely EC 6.3.2.13; catalyzes meso-diaminopimelate addition to UDP-MurNAc-L-Ala-D-Glu during bacterial peptidoglycan biosynthesis.

entities.name: MurE ligase reaction
observations: UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate + meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ATP = UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-gamma-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ADP + phosphate + H(+); Rhea RHEA:23676, EC 6.3.2.13.

entities.name: Magnesium ion cofactor
observations: Reviewed homologs annotate Mg2+ as a cofactor for the MurE ligase reaction; query cofactor assignment is inferred from homology.
